scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && npm-run-all --parallel dev:api dev:web
scripts.build: npm run build -w @inlet/shared && npm run build -w @inlet/api && npm run build -w @inlet/mcp && npm run build -w @inlet/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @inlet/api && npm run typecheck -w @inlet/mcp && npm run typecheck -w @inlet/web
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @inlet/api && npm run test -w @inlet/mcp
scripts.test:unit: npm run build:shared && npm run test:unit -w @inlet/api && npm run test -w @inlet/mcp
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:shared && npm run test:integration -w @inlet/api
scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:e2e
